providers.heading: Providers
providers.description: Providers connect Smart Second Brain to the AI services used for chat, embeddings, and other model-powered features.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.note_access_desc: Choose whether untrusted providers see nothing or everything by default, then manage the matching file list.
privacy.check_updates_desc: Once a day, fetch this plugin's version number from GitHub and show a notice when a newer one is available. Nothing about you or your vault is sent. Skipped while Obsidian's own automatic plugin update check is on.

display.heading: Display
display.result_details_desc: Choose which metadata and context appear in each search result. Currently: {summary}.
display.navbar_search: Use S2B search in the navbar
display.navbar_search_desc: Make the magnifier button in the bottom navbar open Smart Second Brain search instead of Obsidian's quick switcher. Only that button changes — the quick switcher still opens from the command palette and its hotkey.

indexed_content.heading: Indexed content
indexed_content.heading_desc: Notes, canvases and widgets are always indexed. Choose which other files have their contents indexed for search and embeddings — the rest are still found by title and path, and the agent can still read them on demand.
indexed_content.pdfs_desc: Extract and index the text of PDFs. Slow on large libraries, and most of a long PDF is rarely relevant. Long PDFs are indexed up to roughly their first 80 pages (4 on mobile).
indexed_content.chats_desc: Index past conversations. They are mostly the model's own answers, which can then come back as if they were sources.
indexed_content.data_files_desc: Index CSV, JSON and YAML files. Structured data searches poorly by meaning, and a single export can add thousands of entries.

topic_names.heading: Topic names
topic_names.naming_model_desc: Model used to name topics. Without one, a topic is named after its best-connected note.
topic_names.naming_model_desc_withheld: Model used to name topics. Without one, a topic is named after its best-connected note. This provider isn't trusted for private notes, so private titles are withheld from naming.
topic_names.no_provider: No AI provider is configured yet.
topic_names.auto_name_desc: Name topics whenever they change. Off means naming only runs from the graph's Topics panel.

onboarding.heading: Onboarding
onboarding.replay_desc: Reset the splash animation and completion flags — the Welcome view plays its intro again, and auto-opens on startup as if this were a first run (until a provider is configured).
onboarding.reset_notice: Onboarding reset and reopened — the intro will replay from the start.

chat.heading: Chat
chat.raw_tool_io_desc: Reveal the exact tool arguments and raw output blob in chat tool-call rows. Off by default — users see only the plain-language summary and the friendly structured result.
chat.restore_recommendations_desc: Bring back every suggested query, plugin skill nudge, and updated-default notice dismissed from a new chat's empty state.
chat.restore_privacy_warning_desc: Undo 'Don't ask again' on the warning shown before enabling a plugin integration's code-exec tool (it bypasses per-provider privacy rules).
chat.privacy_warning_restored: Integration privacy warning restored — it will show again next time an integration is enabled.
chat.privacy_warning_not_suppressed: Integration privacy warning was not suppressed.

observability.heading: Observability
observability.langsmith_desc: Enable LangSmith telemetry for debugging and tracing
observability.api_key_desc: Select an Obsidian keychain secret for LangSmith authentication
observability.check_aria: Check LangSmith API key and endpoint
observability.check_no_key: Select a LangSmith API key secret first
observability.check_not_found: LangSmith endpoint did not expose the expected API

troubleshooting.release_notes_desc: You are on version {version}. See what changed in recent releases.
troubleshooting.guide_desc: Common problems and how to resolve them — the agent not responding, unhelpful search results, withheld notes, missing MCP tools, and mobile-specific issues.
troubleshooting.still_stuck_desc: Look through existing GitHub issues to see whether the problem is already tracked. If it is not, open a new issue and include what you tried, any error messages, and steps to reproduce it.
troubleshooting.clear_desc: Deletes plugin settings and generated index data. Secrets, skill files, and chat files inside your vault are kept.

clear_modal.title: Clean up plugin data
clear_modal.description: Delete plugin settings and generated index data? Secrets, skill files, and chat files inside your vault will be kept.

troubleshooting.verbose_desc: Enable verbose logging in the Developer Console.
troubleshooting.cleared_partial: Plugin data cleared, but the stored vectors for {indexes} could not be deleted. See the console for details.

providers.delete_embeddings: Also delete the embeddings built with this provider

delete_embeddings_desc.one: Frees the storage used by {formatted} indexed note. Leave this off to keep them — re-adding this provider reuses them instead of re-embedding, which can be slow and costly.
delete_embeddings_desc.other: Frees the storage used by {formatted} indexed notes. Leave this off to keep them — re-adding this provider reuses them instead of re-embedding, which can be slow and costly.

providers.embeddings_kept_starting: Provider removed. Its embeddings were kept — the index service is still starting up.

embeddings_delete_failed.one: Provider removed, but deleting {failed} of {count} embedding index failed: {ids}. See the console for details.
embeddings_delete_failed.other: Provider removed, but deleting {failed} of {count} embedding indexes failed: {ids}. See the console for details.

embedding_index.heading: Embedding indexes
embedding_index.description_search: Embedding indexes power semantic search across your notes.
embedding_index.description_graph: Embedding indexes power semantic graph features across your notes.

orphaned.name: Orphaned vector databases

summary.one: {count} stored database no longer belongs to a configured embedding index{size}: {list}.
summary.other: {count} stored databases no longer belong to a configured embedding index{size}: {list}.

orphaned.origin_usage: Obsidian's storage on this device totals {size} across all vaults.

confirm_desc.one: This permanently removes {count} stored database that no configured embedding index uses. Re-adding one of these models later will rebuild its index from scratch.
confirm_desc.other: This permanently removes {count} stored databases that no configured embedding index uses. Re-adding one of these models later will rebuild its index from scratch.
